page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured within the KVM hypervisor framework. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates a single hardware accelerator with 96 GB of dedicated video RAM (VRAM), making it suitable for memory-intensive graphical and parallel computing workloads. However, the instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high VRAM-to-GPU ratio and dedicated Intel Xeon compute resources, the ecs.gn8v.6xlarge is designed for workloads such as deep learning inference, large-scale model training, and complex data science tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of local storage and the high density of GPU memory position this instance as a specialized resource where users pay for high-capacity accelerator memory without the overhead of local NVMe drives.
